title: Molycube
description: A multiplayer modpack focused on progressive civilization. Start from nothing, found your colony, develop your economy, and connect your kingdoms by train.
body:
# 🌍 MolyCube — Modpack

> *"One moment, the world as we knew it. The next — this world."*

You've been isekai'd. No city, no road, no signal. Just a hostile world, a foreign sky, and other survivors around you.

**MolyCube** is a multiplayer modpack centered around one ambitious concept: **build a civilization from scratch**. Start with nothing. Explore. Survive. Lay the first stones. Where your progression will lead you — that, you'll discover on your own.

---

## 🗺️ Vision

**🪓 The Dawn** — Survive and settle. Explore a world entirely redesigned by Terralith, Incendium and Stellarity. Improve your skills through every action you take. There is no imposed path. Just you, and what you choose to do with this world.

**🏰 The Rise** — *Not yet reached...*

**🚂 The Industrial Era** — *Not yet reached...*

---

## 📦 Mods

| Mod | Role |
|-----|------|
| **Improvable Skills + HammerLib** | RPG character progression |
| **YDM's Weapon Master** | Enhanced combat |
| **Simple Voice Chat** | In-game voice communication |
| **Elytra Slot + Caelus + Curios API** | Dedicated elytra slot |
| **JEI** | Recipe interface |
| **JourneyMap** | Map and waypoints |
| **Terralith** | Enhanced world generation |
| **Incendium** | Redesigned and dangerous Nether |
| **End Remastered** | Revisited End |
| **Stellarity** | Spatial dimensions and enriched End |
| **Towns & Towers** | Enhanced structures and villages |
| **YUNG's API + Better Jungle Temples + Better Ocean Monuments** | Improved structures |
| **Cristel Lib + FerriteCore** | Libraries & performance |

## 🎨 Resource Packs

| Resource Pack | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| **Incendium Textures Reimagined** | Improved textures for Incendium |
| **Stellarity Resource Pack** | Official Stellarity textures |
| **Terralith, Incendium, Nullscape Biomes Names** | In-game biome names |

---

## ⚙️ Technical Info

- **Minecraft Version** : 1.21.1
- **Loader** : NeoForge 21.1.219
- **Multiplayer** : Yes — designed to play in group

---

*Something is coming. But first — survive.*
